scripts.build: if [ "$VERCEL" = "1" ]; then next build; else node ./scripts/prepare-static-export.mjs stash && (ZGIIS_STATIC_EXPORT=1 next build; status=$?; node ./scripts/prepare-static-export.mjs restore; exit $status); fi
scripts.preview: ZGIIS_STATIC_EXPORT=1 npm run build && npx --yes serve out -p 3000
